text: The CAT-DDO 4 is a World Bank-supported contingent credit line that provides the Philippines with rapid access to liquidity in the event of a disaster or public health emergency. It is part of the country's broader disaster risk management and financing strategy, designed to strengthen institutional and financial capacity to manage risks from climate change, natural disasters, and disease outbreaks.

metadata.solution_name: Fourth Disaster Risk Management Development Policy Loan with a Catastrophe-Deferred Drawdown Option (CAT-DDO 4)
